extension_name.message: Cookie Editor — View, Edit & Delete Cookies | CookieDesk

extension_description.message: Inspect, edit, add and delete cookies per site. Search, import/export, partitioned-cookie support. No ads, no tracking.

err_not_stored.message: Chrome accepted "$P1$" but did not store it.

err_imprecise_delete_one.message: Chrome can only delete "$P2$" together with $P1$ other cookie of the same name, so CookieDesk won't delete it.

err_imprecise_delete_other.message: Chrome can only delete "$P2$" together with $P1$ other cookies of the same name, so CookieDesk won't delete it.

err_irreversible_delete.message: Chrome no longer accepts "$P1$" as it is stored, so once deleted it could not be put back. Delete it without undo?

err_no_permission.message: CookieDesk doesn't have access to $P1$. Grant access to this site first.

err_secure_shadow.message: A Secure cookie named "$P1$" already exists for $P2$. Chrome won't let a non-Secure cookie with the same name replace or sit beside it. Turn on Secure, or use a different name.

err_rejected.message: Chrome rejected "$P1$" without giving a reason. Nothing was changed.

err_irreversible_replace_one.message: Chrome no longer accepts $P2$ as it is stored, so once replaced it could not be put back. Continue without undo for it?

err_irreversible_replace_other.message: Chrome no longer accepts $P2$ as they are stored, so once replaced they could not be put back. Continue without undo for them?

err_too_large_to_undo.message: This change touches too much data ($P1$ KB) to keep an undo copy. Continue without undo?

err_duplicate_in_file.message: The file contains "$P1$" twice for the same domain and path.

err_undo_expired.message: Nothing to undo — undo is kept for 10 minutes.

err_undo_conflict.message: $P1$ changed after "$P2$". Undoing now would overwrite the newer value. Undo anyway?

v_bad_draft.message: The cookie must be an object with name, value, domain and path.

v_name_type.message: The cookie name must be text.

v_value_type.message: The cookie value must be text.

v_name_control.message: The name contains control characters (such as a newline or tab), which cookies cannot hold.

v_name_semicolon.message: The name contains ";", which would end the cookie early.

v_name_equals.message: The name contains "=", which separates the name from the value in a cookie.

v_value_control.message: The value contains control characters (such as a newline or tab), which cookies cannot hold.

v_value_semicolon.message: The value contains ";", which would end the cookie early. Encode it (for example with encodeURIComponent).

v_empty_cookie.message: A cookie needs a name or a value; both are empty.

v_empty_name.message: This cookie has an empty name. Some sites and tools handle nameless cookies badly.

v_too_large.message: Name and value together are $P1$ bytes (UTF-8); Chrome allows at most $P2$.

v_path_too_long.message: The path is longer than $P1$ bytes.

v_path_chars.message: The path contains control characters or ";", which cookies cannot hold.

v_domain_empty.message: The domain is empty. Enter the site the cookie belongs to, for example example.com.

v_domain_too_long.message: The domain is longer than $P1$ bytes.

v_domain_invalid.message: The domain is not a valid host name. Use letters, digits and hyphens separated by dots (internationalised names must be in punycode, like xn--...).

v_domain_leading_dot.message: A host-only cookie cannot have a leading dot in its domain; the dot means the cookie also applies to subdomains.

v_domain_public_suffix.message: "$P1$" is a public suffix (a registry-controlled domain like .com or .co.uk), so browsers refuse cookies that apply to all of it.

v_samesite_none_insecure.message: SameSite=None cookies must be Secure — Chrome rejects them otherwise. Turn on Secure or choose another SameSite.

v_partitioned_insecure.message: Partitioned cookies must be Secure — Chrome rejects them otherwise. Turn on Secure or remove the partition.

v_prefix_secure.message: Cookies named "$P1$..." must be Secure. Turn on Secure or rename the cookie.

v_host_prefix_domain.message: Cookies named "__Host-..." must be host-only (no Domain attribute, so no subdomain sharing). Turn on host-only or rename the cookie.

v_host_prefix_path.message: Cookies named "__Host-..." must have the path "/".

v_bad_expiration.message: The expiration must be a finite number of seconds since 1970.

v_expired_deletes.message: Saving with an expiry in the past deletes this cookie.

v_clamped.message: Chrome limits cookie lifetime to $P1$ days; a later expiry is shortened when saved.

v_expiration_missing.message: A non-session cookie needs an expiration date. Pick one or mark the cookie as a session cookie.

v_partition_type.message: The partition key must be an object with a topLevelSite.

v_partition_site_type.message: The partition's top-level site must be text like https://example.com.

v_partition_site_form.message: The partition's top-level site must look like https://example.com (https, no path or port).

v_partition_flag.message: The partition's hasCrossSiteAncestor must be true or false.

v_partition_cross_site.message: The cookie's domain is not on the same site as $P1$, so Chrome requires hasCrossSiteAncestor to be true for it.

v_other_site.message: This cookie's domain ($P1$) is outside the current site ($P2$).

io_partition_key.message: $P1$: partitionKey must be an object with a text topLevelSite.

io_too_large.message: The file is larger than the $P1$-byte import limit.

io_bad_json.message: The file looks like JSON but could not be parsed.

io_bad_version.message: This CookieDesk file has an unsupported version.

io_no_cookie_list.message: The CookieDesk file has no "cookies" list.

io_too_many.message: The file has $P1$ cookies; the limit is $P2$.

io_duplicate.message: $P1$: another entry has the same name, domain, path and partition.

explain_third_party.message: Set by $P1$, a different site from $P2$: a third-party cookie.

explain_third_party_partitioned.message: Set by $P1$, a different site from $P2$: a third-party cookie, kept in the partition of $P2$.

explain_host_prefix.message: The __Host- prefix makes Chrome insist on Secure, no Domain attribute and Path=/, so no subdomain can set or replace it.

explain_secure_prefix.message: The __Secure- prefix makes Chrome accept it only with the Secure flag.

explain_scope_host.message: Sent only to $P1$ itself, not to its subdomains.

explain_scope_domain.message: Sent to $P1$ and every subdomain of it (such as www.$P1$).

explain_path_all.message: Sent with requests for every path on that host.

explain_path_under.message: Sent only with requests for paths under $P1$.

explain_not_secure.message: Not Secure: also sent over plain HTTP, where anyone on the network can read it.

explain_httponly.message: HttpOnly: not visible to page JavaScript (document.cookie can't read it), which keeps it away from injected scripts.

explain_script_readable.message: Readable and changeable by any script running on the page.

explain_samesite_none.message: SameSite=None: may also be sent with cross-site requests (embedded frames, images, requests from other sites), where Chrome allows third-party cookies at all (incognito blocks them by default). That is why it must be Secure.

explain_samesite_lax.message: SameSite=Lax: sent when you navigate to the site, including from a link on another site, but not with requests other sites' pages make in the background.

explain_samesite_strict.message: SameSite=Strict: only sent when you are already on the same site. Arriving from a link on another site, the first request goes without it.

explain_samesite_unset.message: No SameSite attribute: Chrome treats it as Lax.

explain_session.message: A session cookie: deleted when the browser closes (unless Chrome restores your previous session on startup).

explain_expires.message: Expires $P1$. Chrome caps any expiry at 400 days from when the cookie was last set.

explain_partition.message: Partitioned (CHIPS): stored separately for each top-level site. This copy is only sent while $P1$ is the site in the address bar.

explain_partition_cross.message: It is in the cross-site part of that partition (used where another site sits between the page and this cookie's site), kept apart from the same-site part.

explain_partition_same.message: It is in the same-site part of that partition, kept apart from the cross-site part.

explain_partition_other.message: The same cookie name under another site is a different cookie.

explain_jwt.message: The value looks like a JSON Web Token.

explain_jwt_exp.message: The value looks like a JSON Web Token; the token itself says it expires $P1$.

explain_size.message: $P1$ of the 4096 bytes Chrome allows for name and value together.
